_meta.description: Key milestones of Line 2B, oldest first. 'date_precision' is day, month or year. 'kind' is planning, approval, tender, award, construction, related or future. Only events whose source was read are listed.

events.title: MMRDA approves the draft plan: 23.6 km, 22 stations
events.summary: MMRDA approves the draft plan for the D N Nagar-Mankhurd corridor, at about Rs 10,970 crore, with ADB funding planned and completion by the end of 2019.

events.title: State Cabinet approves Line 2B
events.summary: The Maharashtra Cabinet approves Metro 2B together with Metro 4. The project report puts Line 2B at Rs 10,986 crore.

events.title: Foundation stone
events.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis lay the foundation stones of Lines 2B and 4 in Mumbai.

events.title: Western section to Simplex Infrastructures
events.summary: Civil package CA-04B, about 12.7 km from D N Nagar towards BKC, goes to Simplex Infrastructures.

events.title: Eastern section contracts awarded
events.summary: CA-06 (MTNL Metro to Chembur) to RCC Infra Ventures and MBZ (JV), Rs 521.21 crore, and CA-07 (Diamond Garden to Mandale) to Neeraj-Guan (JV), Rs 393.01 crore, the lowest bids.

events.title: CA-07, Diamond Garden to Mandale, to NCC
events.summary: After several rounds of re-bidding, NCC takes the civil package for the five stations from Diamond Garden to Mandale.

events.title: Three contracts ended for poor progress
events.summary: MMRDA ends the contracts of Simplex Infrastructures (CA-04B) and of RCC Infra Ventures and MBZ (CA-06 and the Mandale depot, CA-14) for poor progress, and tenders the balance works again.

events.title: First U-girders
events.summary: NCC places the first two U-girders, 25 m long, near Deonar depot east of Shivaji Chowk station.

events.title: Mandale depot to Ahluwalia Contracts
events.summary: The balance civil works of the Mandale depot (L2B-C103) go to Ahluwalia Contracts for Rs 530.32 crore after negotiation.

events.title: D N Nagar to ILFS to J Kumar Infraprojects
events.summary: J Kumar Infraprojects receives the balance works of the western section (L2B-C101): 12.824 km and 10 stations, ESIC Nagar to ILFS, for Rs 1,307.88 crore over 30 months.

events.title: MTNL Metro to Chembur to NCC
events.summary: NCC receives the balance works of CA-06 (L2B-C102): 5.868 km and five stations, MTNL Metro to Chembur, over 36 months. Its bid was Rs 791.15 crore.

events.title: Extension to Cheetah Camp ordered
events.summary: MMRDA orders the line extended about 1 km past Mandale to Cheetah Camp, with one more station, at Rs 205 crore.

events.title: Electrical and mechanical works for Phase I
events.summary: Colossus Infra Projects wins the electrical and mechanical works of the five stations from Diamond Garden to Mandale (CA-249), Rs 33.95 crore.

events.title: Trial runs begin, Mandale to Diamond Garden
events.summary: MMRDA starts trial runs on the 5.5 km stretch from Diamond Garden to Mandale.

events.title: Safety commissioner's final inspection begins
events.summary: The Commissioner of Metro Rail Safety begins the final inspection of the 5.39 km Mandale-Diamond Garden stretch.

events.title: Phase I opens, Mandale to Diamond Garden
events.summary: Five stations and 5.5 km open: Mandale, Mankhurd, BSNL Metro, Shivaji Chowk and Diamond Garden. Inaugurated on 7 Apr, open to riders from 8 Apr.

events.title: Three girders over the Central Railway
events.summary: MMRDA launches three composite steel girders across the Central Railway between Kurla and Vidyavihar within two weeks, over running suburban lines, in short railway blocks.

events.title: Phase IA opens: Chembur
events.summary: Chembur station opens, 0.29 km past Diamond Garden, close to the Harbour line and the Monorail.

events.title: Reported target: Diamond Garden to Saraswat Nagar
events.summary: Free Press Journal (Apr 2026) gives 2027 as the scheduled completion of the next stretch. MMRDA has announced no date.
